We value proactive individuals who bring energy, focus, and integrity to every shift — ensuring safety is always our top priority.

jobs.title: Event Security Officers – Level II & Level III
jobs.description:
We are seeking professional, dependable, and experienced security officers to support event operations alongside event staff, venue security, local law enforcement.

Positions Available

  • Level II Non-Commissioned Security Officers
  • Level III Commissioned Security Officers

Level II Non-Commissioned Security OfficerPosition Summary

Level II Officers will provide professional, uniformed security support throughout the event. Officers will primarily be assigned to access-control, observation, guest-flow, and security-presence posts.

Responsibilities

  • Staff assigned security posts, including entrances, interior doorways, stairwells, corridors, registration areas, and other designated locations.
  • Maintain a professional and visible security presence.
  • Monitor assigned areas for unauthorized access, disturbances, suspicious activity, safety concerns, or violations of event policies.
  • Assist with orderly guest movement and crowd flow.
  • Provide basic directions and assistance to guests when appropriate.
  • Report security incidents or concerns through the established chain of command.
  • Assist event leadership, venue security, and law enforcement personnel as directed.
  • Respond appropriately to disturbances, safety concerns, or medical incidents until relieved by emergency personnel.
  • Remain at your assigned post unless properly relieved or directed otherwise.
  • Complete required incident documentation.

Important: Event personnel, not Level II officers, will have primary responsibility for validating invitations and checking guest identification.

Level II Requirements

  • Current Texas DPS Non-Commissioned Security Officer (Level II) license, or higher applicable Texas security license.
  • Must be eligible for affiliation with RKSMS through the Texas Online Private Security system prior to the event.
  • Must have completed all required Texas training and licensing requirements.
  • Level II officers will not carry firearms while performing security duties.
  • Professional appearance and conduct.
  • Strong communication and situational-awareness skills.
  • Ability to remain standing and attentive for extended periods.

Level III Commissioned Security OfficerPosition Summary

Level III Officers will provide armed security coverage at strategically designated locations throughout the event. Officers will supplement Level II personnel and support areas requiring an elevated security presence and rapid-response capability.

Responsibilities

  • Staff designated armed-security posts at higher-risk or strategically important locations.
  • Maintain a professional and highly visible armed-security presence.
  • Monitor assigned areas for threats, disturbances, unauthorized access, suspicious activity, and safety concerns.
  • Provide immediate security response when directed by event leadership.
  • Assist with de-escalation and management of security incidents within the officer's authority and training.
  • Coordinate with event leadership, venue security, and law enforcement when necessary.
  • Maintain strict firearms safety, weapons-retention, and use-of-force discipline.
  • Remain at the assigned post unless properly relieved or redirected.
  • Complete required incident documentation.

Level III Requirements

  • Current and active Texas DPS Commissioned Security Officer (Level III) license.
  • Must be eligible for affiliation prior to the event.
  • Completion of required Level III training, testing, and firearms qualification.
  • Must meet all applicable Texas DPS firearms requirements.
  • Must be qualified with the type/category of firearm authorized for use at the event.
  • Strong situational awareness, communication, and professional judgment.
  • Ability to remain attentive and professional in a large, high-profile event environment.

Ideal Candidates

We are looking for security professionals who are:

  • Licensed and in good standing with Texas DPS.
  • Reliable and punctual.
  • Professional and customer-service oriented.
  • Comfortable working in a large-scale event environment.
  • Able to follow post orders and the established chain of command.
  • Experienced with crowd management, access control, event security, or similar assignments.

Pay: $19.00 - $21.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Commisson Officer Level 3
jobs.description:
Commissioned Security Officer – Level III NEEDED!!!!

Command Security Inc is seeking a reliable, professional, and highly experienced Commissioned Security Officer – Level III to provide security at a client facility in Dallas, TX.

This position requires a strong security presence, excellent situational awareness, and the ability to interact professionally with staff, visitors, and members of the public. The ideal candidate is dependable, alert, and capable of handling security concerns while maintaining a safe and professional environment.

Position: Armed Security Officer – Commissioned Level III

Location: Dallas, TX

Schedule

  • Monday to Friday 7:30am-4pm

Pay

$$21.00-22.00 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.

Position Overview

The Armed Security Officer will maintain a highly visible security presence at the assigned facility and help protect personnel, visitors, property, and assets.

The officer will monitor the facility, control access points, respond to incidents, conduct security checks, communicate with management and emergency personnel when necessary, and complete detailed security documentation.

Job Duties

  • Maintain a highly visible armed security presence throughout the assigned facility.
  • Monitor entrances, exits, and designated access points.
  • Control and monitor access to the facility in accordance with post orders.
  • Conduct routine security checks and patrols of assigned areas.
  • Monitor CCTV and other security systems as assigned.
  • Respond promptly to radio/walkie-talkie communications.
  • Identify and respond appropriately to suspicious activity, safety concerns, and security incidents.
  • Utilize professional conflict resolution and de-escalation techniques.
  • Respond to emergencies in accordance with company policies and post orders.
  • Contact law enforcement, fire department, EMS, or other emergency services when appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate Daily Activity Reports (DARs) and incident reports.
  • Communicate professionally with client management, employees, visitors, and emergency personnel.
  • Maintain assigned firearm and equipment in accordance with company policies and applicable Texas laws and regulations.
  • Maintain a professional and courteous demeanor at all times.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support the security operation.

Requirements

  • Valid Texas DPS Commissioned Security Officer – Level III License REQUIRED.
  • Must be currently authorized to perform armed security work in Texas.
  • Must maintain all required Texas DPS licenses, registrations, and qualifications in good standing.
  • Minimum 8 years of security experience preferred.
  • Previous armed security, law enforcement, military, corporate security, or high-visibility security experience preferred.
  • Excellent observation and situational-awareness skills.
  • Strong communication and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Strong conflict-resolution and de-escalation skills.
  • Must be comfortable using radios, CCTV, access-control systems, and other security technology.
  • Must be able to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Must follow all company policies, client requirements, and post orders.
  • Must maintain a professional appearance and report to work in complete uniform.
  • Reliable transportation to the Dallas, TX location.
  • Must be dependable, punctual, and professional.

IMPORTANT

This is an armed security position at a professional client facility. The officer will be responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment while providing a professional and courteous presence.

Applicants must possess a valid Texas DPS Commissioned Security Officer (Level III) License and meet all applicable requirements to perform armed security services in Texas.

Only qualified applicants who meet the Texas DPS requirements for commissioned armed security officers will be considered. Please call 713-291-7829 for more information, ask for Demon.

Pay: $21.00 - $22.00 per hour

  • Do you have your proper credentials listed on the ad?
  • Are you available to work the schedule posted?
  • When are you available to start?

jobs.title: (Level III) - Commissioned Security Guard
jobs.description:
GREAT Hiring Opportunity for Security Guards Level III-Commissioned! AAA Security Guard Services is your opportunity to work with an elite team of professional officers in the security field. As a professional security officer, your primary responsibility will be to create a safe and secure environment for our clients. You will be required to protect the premises, assets, and employees of our clients. Also, you will be required to prevent any illegal or inappropriate occurrences that may occur. The ideal candidate has knowledge and experience in the security field and public safety. Must have the ability to communicate effectively, be professional and operate with a high degree of integrity at all times. All applicants must have an active Security Guard Level III Certification and Pocket Card!!

Responsibilities

Patrol the premises and maintain a high level of visibility
Monitor entrances and exits to ensure only authorized personnel access the facility
Remove trespassers when necessary
Monitor surveillance cameras
Respond to reports of suspicious activity
Report on daily activities and any security incidents

Qualifications

Must have an active State of Texas Commissioned (Level III) Security Guard License and Pocket Card.
Previous experience as a Commissioned Security Officer, Level III (2+ yrs); similar or military experience
Must have own weapon, duty belt, handcuffs, baton, and OC Spray (must have OC Spray certification)
High school diploma/GED
Strong understanding of security procedures and public safety
Excellent written communication skills and report writing ability
Ability to operate surveillance equipment
High level of integrity, accountability and professionalism
Attention to detail and strong observational skills
Ability to work without direct supervision
Ability to work 10 -12 hour shifts

Apply Online at https://aaa-security-guard-services-llc.careerplug.com/j/02j0mlp
